_doc: Initial detector input for Folsom CFD 2014-1 (Folsom Ranch south-of-50 master-planned area). Late-filer test case.

value_to_lien_collapse.source: 5 YFSR reports due but not received per CDIAC Figure 13

buildout_stalled.source: Folsom Ranch is actively building out; no concrete data

issuer_administration_concern.source: CDIAC RY 2023-24 Figure 13 — 5 reports due not received, the largest single-CFD deficit in the state

_notes: Sole high-confidence fire is issuer_administration_concern, but the SEVERITY is extreme (5 missing reports = administrative breakdown). This alone justifies exclusion per the framework. Underlying credit could still be fine — Folsom Ranch is a healthy growth area — but the framework's exclusion principle is exactly this: if we can't see the data, we can't underwrite the credit.
